Bay Street Senior Housing

Bay St, Staten Island

Applications are being accepted for income restricted Low Income Housing Tax Credit (LIHTC) 1 bedroom apartments.  At least 1 member of the household must be 62 years or older.  Minimum income to apply is $50,062, federal & state rental subsidy/ assistance accepted. 

Address: 533-539 Bay St 533-539 Bay St, Staten Island, NY 1030

Experience the comfort and community of Bay Street Senior Housing, located at 533-539 Bay Street in Staten Island, NY. This inviting property, established in 2017, is designed specifically for seniors seeking a vibrant, supportive environment. With 67 thoughtfully designed low-income units, Bay Street Senior Housing provides an ideal living space that fosters connection and independence. Residents can enjoy a peaceful lifestyle while being part of a welcoming community that prioritizes their needs and well-being. Embrace the opportunity for social engagement and a fulfilling lifestyle at this exceptional low-income tax credit property, where comfort meets convenience in a scenic Staten Island setting.
